summary: TransAlta Corp filed a 6-K containing an underwriting agreement to sell 18,230,000 common shares at C$19.20 per share (aggregate C$350 million) with an over-allotment option for up to 2,734,500 additional shares. The syndicate is led by CIBC and RBC as joint bookrunners; underwriting fee is 4%. This is a conventional equity offering, not a special situation. The filing is routine capital raising through a prospectus supplement in Canada and a registration statement in the US.
